thread:
rachel: Heads-up: onboarding user reported instant 429s during signup in the sample app. digging in — seems tied to prefetch + auth refresh.

tony: confirmed in staging. when the SDK refreshes credentials mid-prefetch we end up with a fan-out: multiple workers request the same pagination cursor concurrently. server sees bursts and returns 429s.

priya: quick repro: set PREFETCH_WINDOW=3, start app, force token expiry at ~500ms after load, then click Create Account. network shows repeated GET /records?cursor=xyz.

jen: logs sample: ```
[2025-05-02T09:05:21.100Z] prefetch worker=3 cursor=xyz
[2025-05-02T09:05:21.450Z] auth: refresh start
[2025-05-02T09:05:21.700Z] http 429 GET /records?cursor=xyz (concurrent=4)
[2025-05-02T09:05:21.980Z] retry backoff=120ms
```

rachel: current SDK behavior: prefetch loop continues regardless of auth state and we don’t dedupe inflight fetches. retries are exponential but amplify the initial spike.

tony: suggested fixes: (1) singleflight/dedupe by cursor key, (2) pause new prefetch starts while auth.refreshInProgress is true, (3) add per-fetch AbortController so stale prefetches can be cancelled.

priya: singleflight sketch: ```js
const inFlight = new Map()
if (inFlight.has(key)) return inFlight.get(key)
const p = fetchPage(key, {signal})
inFlight.set(key, p)
p.finally(()=> inFlight.delete(key))
return p
```

jen: add jitter to prefetch startup and a small random delay on retry to avoid synchronized retries from N workers. e.g., backoff = base * (1 + Math.random()).

rachel: operational asks: add an opt-in prefetch_mode: "onboarding" (conservative defaults), and telemetry counter `sdk.prefetch.duplicate_requests` to measure impact. we should change sample-app starter to conservative mode by default for signup flow.

tony: parity note: JS will need those flags exposed, but we must coordinate with py/go SDKs. propose stable opt-in config shape: prefetch: { mode: 'default' | 'conservative' | 'dedupe', max_concurrency: number } — default stays backward compatible.

priya: tests: unit tests for singleflight, plus an e2e that forces token expiry and asserts <=1 request per cursor per 200ms window. CI job can run in staging with a token-expiry hook.

infra-bot: Created CI pipeline devex/prefetch-auth-race-e2e requested by @rachel — runs in staging with forced expiry.

jen: small workaround for customers: set PREFETCH_WINDOW=1 during signup or add `prefetch_mode: 'conservative'` to starter config until we ship. document in onboarding guide.

rachel: i'll own a small PR: implement singleflight + AbortController + config flag + telemetry. will include unit tests and add an entry in CHANGELOG for non-breaking opt-in. tagging @devex and @sdk.

tony: if PR looks good, roll out sample-app change first, flip default only after 2 weeks of telemetry.

priya: also consider server-side graceful 429 headers that suggest a cooldown; SDK could respect Retry-After and backoff more aggressively during prefetch.

rachel: noted. thanks team — follow-up sync tomorrow 10am PT to pick final defaults and timeline.
